.vf-links p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: rgb(187, 205, 206); max-width: 290px; }
.vf-links nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; font-size: 16px; }
.vf-links nav strong { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: rgb(158, 182, 186); font-weight: 400; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.vf-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.19); color: rgb(180, 199, 201); font-size: 13px; }
.vf-bottom div { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.vf a:focus-visible { outline: rgb(177, 216, 242) solid 2px; outline-offset: 5px; }
.vf-inner { padding: 48px 28px 24px; }
.vf-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 28px; }
.vf-actions { justify-content: flex-start; }
.vf h2 { font-size: 38px; }
.vf-links { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
.vf-inner { padding: 40px 24px 24px; }
.vf h2 { font-size: 33px; }
.vf-top p { font-size: 18px; }
.vf-actions { gap: 12px; }
.vf-actions a { font-size: 16px; padding: 13px 17px; }
.vf-links { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
.vf-links > div { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.vf-bottom { gap: 18px; }
.vf-bottom div { gap: 16px; }
